checks.statement: Provide page context, navigation, and one or two essential actions in the app bar.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured App bars guidance.

evidence.result: The preview renders a Back control, visible title, and two trailing actions, but it does not establish real page context or whether those actions are essential.

implementation.notes: The preview renders a Back control, visible title, and two trailing actions, but it does not establish real page context or whether those actions are essential.

checks.statement: Prefer medium flexible and large flexible app bars over baseline medium and large variants in M3 Expressive; baseline medium and large are no longer recommended.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured M3 Expressive update guidance.

evidence.result: The variant matrix exposes flexible medium/large alongside baseline medium/large variants; the catalog does not enforce the recommendation when an application selects one.

implementation.notes: The variant matrix exposes flexible medium/large alongside baseline medium/large variants; the catalog does not enforce the recommendation when an application selects one.

checks.statement: Use the search app bar and flexible medium/large variants only for M3 Expressive; the search bar and flexible variants are unavailable in baseline M3.
checks.condition: When selecting an upstream variant; M3 means baseline.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Variants guidance.

evidence.result: Generated app-bar configurations enumerate search control and flexible variants; availability is configured as variants, not gated by an app-level Material mode.

implementation.notes: Generated app-bar configurations enumerate search control and flexible variants; availability is configured as variants, not gated by an app-level Material mode.

checks.statement: Use leading-edge title alignment by default; centered alignment is an M3 Expressive option and is unavailable in baseline M3.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Text alignment guidance.

evidence.result: Centered and baseline-centered selectors/configurations exist, while the regular copy remains leading aligned; mode availability is a caller choice.

implementation.notes: Centered and baseline-centered selectors/configurations exist, while the regular copy remains leading aligned; mode availability is a caller choice.

checks.statement: App bars may include an image or logo, subtitle, and a single filled icon button; avoid changing heading or subtitle size or adding too many actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Anatomy guidance.

evidence.result: The specimen includes title/subtitle and two actions, but does not implement application-level limits on custom contents or typography.

implementation.notes: The specimen includes title/subtitle and two actions, but does not implement application-level limits on custom contents or typography.

checks.statement: Selecting the search app bar opens the search view; trailing actions may sit inside or outside the search field.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Search guidance.

evidence.result: The search variant renders a native search input. The only app-bar behavior marks scroll state; it does not open a search view on selection.

implementation.notes: The search variant renders a native search input. The only app-bar behavior marks scroll state; it does not open a search view on selection.

checks.statement: Keep app bar content contextual to the current page and limit it to one action, or two when necessary; move larger action sets to a toolbar.
checks.condition: When a page has multiple actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

evidence.result: The preview hard-codes two trailing actions and a menu icon; it does not know the page context or relocate excess actions to a toolbar.

implementation.notes: The preview hard-codes two trailing actions and a menu icon; it does not know the page context or relocate excess actions to a toolbar.

checks.statement: Use at most one filled or tonal button in an app bar to emphasize its primary action.
checks.condition: When emphasizing an app bar action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

evidence.result: The app-bar preview has icon actions and an optional single FAB; it does not place multiple filled/tonal emphasis buttons in one app bar.

implementation.notes: The app-bar preview has icon actions and an optional single FAB; it does not place multiple filled/tonal emphasis buttons in one app bar.

checks.statement: Use a small app bar for dense layouts or after a flexible app bar collapses on scroll.
checks.condition: When choosing among app bar variants.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Baseline app bars guidance.

evidence.result: Scroll behavior only adds data-scrolled while the app bar stays sticky; no variant transition selects a small bar.

implementation.notes: Scroll behavior only adds data-scrolled while the app bar stays sticky; no variant transition selects a small bar.

checks.statement: On large screens, constrain app bar content to a maximum width and center it.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Large screens guidance.

evidence.result: The demo wrapper caps at 28rem and the component fills its parent; no large-breakpoint content max-width and centering rule exists.

implementation.notes: The demo wrapper caps at 28rem and the component fills its parent; no large-breakpoint content max-width and centering rule exists.

checks.statement: On scroll, change the app bar container to a surface-container fill to separate it from content; do not use a drop shadow for this state.
checks.condition: When content scrolls beneath an M3 app bar.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scrolling guidance.

evidence.result: The scroll handler only toggles data-scrolled; stylesheet transitions background but contains no scrolled-state container fill or no-shadow rule. Generated token selector is present, so the computed fill/elevation outcome needs a rendered-style check.

implementation.notes: The scroll handler only toggles data-scrolled; stylesheet transitions background but contains no scrolled-state container fill or no-shadow rule. Generated token selector is present, so the computed fill/elevation outcome needs a rendered-style check.

checks.statement: Place initial keyboard focus on the leading button, then let Tab move through interactive elements; Space or Enter activates the focused action.
checks.condition: When the app bar receives keyboard focus.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Initial focus guidance.

evidence.result: Native controls occur in DOM order (leading Back, search/title, then trailing buttons); the preview adds no positive tabindex or custom focus movement.

implementation.notes: Native controls occur in DOM order (leading Back, search/title, then trailing buttons); the preview adds no positive tabindex or custom focus movement.

checks.statement: Make the title accessibility label match its visible text, adding context only when needed; label icon buttons by their action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements guidance.

evidence.result: Title text is rendered visibly; icon actions receive action-specific aria-labels from BarAction. The heading itself has no explicit accessible-name override.

implementation.notes: Title text is rendered visibly; icon actions receive action-specific aria-labels from BarAction. The heading itself has no explicit accessible-name override.

checks.statement: In M3 Expressive, flexible medium and large variants have reduced height, larger titles, subtitles, text wrapping, and more flexible image and filled-button content; small app bars also gain subtitles and centered text.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured M3 Expressive update instructions.

evidence.result: Flexible variants render title/subtitle and expanded placement, but the title rule forces nowrap and ellipsis; larger typography/image/filled-button capability needs variant-specific rendered assessment.

implementation.notes: Flexible variants render title/subtitle and expanded placement, but the title rule forces nowrap and ellipsis; larger typography/image/filled-button capability needs variant-specific rendered assessment.

checks.statement: In M3 Expressive, replace baseline medium and large app bars with their flexible variants, which are shorter, support multiline headlines, and accommodate a wider range of elements.
checks.condition: When using baseline M3 app bars in M3 Expressive.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Baseline variants instructions.

evidence.result: Baseline title typography is set, but all title variants inherit nowrap/ellipsis, so the required multiline headline support is absent.

implementation.notes: Baseline title typography is set, but all title variants inherit nowrap/ellipsis, so the required multiline headline support is absent.

checks.statement: An image may replace the label text in a small app bar.
checks.condition: When a small app bar uses an image.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Image instructions.

evidence.result: No small-bar configuration replaces its title with an image. The source permits that optional composition; its absence is not a failed requirement.

implementation.notes: No small-bar configuration replaces its title with an image. The source permits that optional composition; its absence is not a failed requirement.

checks.statement: Replace trailing icon buttons with at most one filled icon button, using primary or tonal styling and default or wide size.
checks.condition: When emphasizing a trailing app bar action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Filled trailing icon button instructions.

evidence.result: The preview supplies two trailing icon buttons and a separate optional FAB, but does not expose a filled/tonal icon-button trailing style; actual caller composition is not constrained.

implementation.notes: The preview supplies two trailing icon buttons and a separate optional FAB, but does not expose a filled/tonal icon-button trailing style; actual caller composition is not constrained.

checks.statement: Flexible medium and large app bars size their container to the headline and subtitle content, increasing height when a subtitle is present.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Subtitle instructions.

evidence.result: Flexible variants have a fixed app-bar block-size token and absolutely positioned expanded copy; source does not show content-driven height growth when a subtitle is present.

implementation.notes: Flexible variants have a fixed app-bar block-size token and absolutely positioned expanded copy; source does not show content-driven height growth when a subtitle is present.

checks.statement: On scroll, use the surface-container role for the app bar container; app bar colors use shared roles across variants.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Color instructions.

evidence.result: Generator maps app-bar container color and data-scrolled token selectors, but the behavior only toggles the attribute; the resulting token-resolved role needs computed-style inspection.

implementation.notes: Generator maps app-bar container color and data-scrolled token selectors, but the behavior only toggles the attribute; the resulting token-resolved role needs computed-style inspection.

checks.statement: The search field may change color in its scrolled state.
checks.condition: For a search app bar that changes state on scroll.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scroll states instructions.

evidence.result: Search color variables are token-bound and search input inherits its field color, but no explicit scrolled-search selector appears in this stylesheet; verify generated selectors and resolved colors in browser.

implementation.notes: Search color variables are token-bound and search input inherits its field color, but no explicit scrolled-search selector appears in this stylesheet; verify generated selectors and resolved colors in browser.

checks.statement: Use the search app bar on a home page when search is central to the product, as an emphasized entry point to the search view.
checks.condition: When search is a key product task.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Search app bar instructions.

evidence.result: This is an isolated component preview without a product home page or task analytics, so centrality of search to a product cannot be established.

implementation.notes: This is an isolated component preview without a product home page or task analytics, so centrality of search to a product cannot be established.

checks.statement: Include the word “Search” in the search prompt; name a specific area or product when helpful and use the product’s capitalization style.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Search app bar instructions.

evidence.result: The rendered placeholder is “Search” and the input has an accessible name “Search preview”.

implementation.notes: The rendered placeholder is “Search” and the input has an accessible name “Search preview”.

checks.statement: On mobile, allow up to two trailing icons in addition to an avatar; order actions from most used at the leading side to least used at the trailing side.
checks.condition: For a mobile search app bar.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Buttons in search app bar instructions.

evidence.result: The preview can show two trailing controls and an avatar variant, but has no mobile breakpoint or ordering logic tied to usage frequency.

implementation.notes: The preview can show two trailing controls and an avatar variant, but has no mobile breakpoint or ordering logic tied to usage frequency.

checks.statement: A leading logo may be decorative or return to home/refresh, but must not open an expanded navigation rail.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Buttons in search app bar instructions.

evidence.result: The specimen has a Back icon as its leading control and no leading-logo configuration, so logo navigation behavior is not exercised.

implementation.notes: The specimen has a Back icon as its leading control and no leading-logo configuration, so logo navigation behavior is not exercised.

checks.statement: Do not exceed two trailing icon buttons plus an avatar; move additional actions to a toolbar.
checks.condition: For a mobile search app bar.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Buttons in search app bar instructions.

evidence.result: The preview renders two trailing buttons or one button plus avatar; no responsive overflow/toolbar relocation behavior is wired to action count.

implementation.notes: The preview renders two trailing buttons or one button plus avatar; no responsive overflow/toolbar relocation behavior is wired to action count.

checks.statement: Allow up to four trailing icons in a search app bar on larger screens.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Large screens instructions.

evidence.result: The specimen fixes two trailing buttons; its 28rem demo width does not implement a larger-screen breakpoint allowing four.

implementation.notes: The specimen fixes two trailing buttons; its 28rem demo width does not implement a larger-screen breakpoint allowing four.

checks.statement: Use surface container by default, or surface bright when the surrounding background is darker; maintain at least 3:1 contrast between search text and its container.
checks.condition: When styling a search field in an app bar.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Alternate color options instructions.

evidence.result: Token-backed field/container colors are assigned, but the required 3:1 ratio and bright-vs-container choice are not established by source alone; needs computed-color/contrast probe.

implementation.notes: Token-backed field/container colors are assigned, but the required 3:1 ratio and bright-vs-container choice are not established by source alone; needs computed-color/contrast probe.

checks.statement: Keep the container’s default position and straight corners, use its default height, and span the full window width.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container instructions.

evidence.result: Container fills its parent and uses tokenized height/shape; the resolved default height/straight-corner geometry and window-width scope need runtime token values (demo is capped at 28rem).

implementation.notes: Container fills its parent and uses tokenized height/shape; the resolved default height/straight-corner geometry and window-width scope need runtime token values (demo is capped at 28rem).

checks.statement: Use a high-quality, relevant logo that does not disrupt app bar functionality; in a small app bar it can replace all text, and in other variants it can sit above the text.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Adding logos instructions.

evidence.result: No logo asset is rendered in the app-bar specimen; logo quality and relevance are product content decisions.

implementation.notes: No logo asset is rendered in the app-bar specimen; logo quality and relevance are product content decisions.

checks.statement: Use the leading button for product navigation, typically a menu opening the expanded navigation rail or a Back action returning to the previous screen.
checks.condition: For a leading app bar button.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Leading button instructions.

evidence.result: The preview’s leading icon is labeled Back, matching a return-navigation purpose; actual destination behavior is outside the specimen.

implementation.notes: The preview’s leading icon is labeled Back, matching a return-navigation purpose; actual destination behavior is outside the specimen.

checks.statement: Keep headlines brief enough to fit; flexible medium and large variants may wrap to at most two lines, while small app bar headlines must not wrap or truncate.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Headline instructions.

evidence.result: Every app-bar title is forced to one line and clipped with ellipsis; flexible variants therefore cannot wrap to two lines as recommended.

implementation.notes: Every app-bar title is forced to one line and clipped with ellipsis; flexible variants therefore cannot wrap to two lines as recommended.

checks.statement: Align a subtitle to the same leading or center alignment as its headline.
checks.condition: When an app bar includes a subtitle.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Subtitle instructions.

evidence.result: Title and subtitle share one grid copy container; centered variant centers that container’s text and other variants use leading alignment.

implementation.notes: Title and subtitle share one grid copy container; centered variant centers that container’s text and other variants use leading alignment.

checks.statement: Place at most two icon buttons after the headline, with the most-used action nearer the leading edge; for a filled or tonal icon style, use only one button.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Trailing icon buttons instructions.

evidence.result: The template orders two icon actions and uses flex layout; it cannot determine action importance or enforce filled/tonal count for application content.

implementation.notes: The template orders two icon actions and uses flex layout; it cannot determine action importance or enforce filled/tonal count for application content.

checks.statement: Do not use trailing icon buttons to open a menu of more actions; move larger action sets to a toolbar.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Trailing icon buttons instructions.

evidence.result: The preview includes a menu icon but no more-actions menu/toolbar relocation; the component cannot determine whether a page has excess actions.

implementation.notes: The preview includes a menu icon but no more-actions menu/toolbar relocation; the component cannot determine whether a page has excess actions.

checks.statement: Prefer filled icons for visible actions; outlined icons are appropriate when needed, especially for unselected toggle buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Trailing icon buttons instructions.

evidence.result: App-bar trailing controls use the standard icon-button class and no forced filled variant; selection of an optional style remains available through token styling.

implementation.notes: App-bar trailing controls use the standard icon-button class and no forced filled variant; selection of an optional style remains available through token styling.

checks.statement: Keep the app bar container at 100% of the window width.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Resizing instructions.

evidence.result: The component is 100% of its containing block, but the showcase parent is capped at 28rem; a real window-wide host is not present in this specimen.

implementation.notes: The component is 100% of its containing block, but the showcase parent is capped at 28rem; a real window-wide host is not present in this specimen.

checks.statement: At smaller breakpoints, trailing actions may collapse into an overflow menu and reappear at larger sizes.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Resizing instructions.

evidence.result: The source permits collapsing actions into overflow; this specimen does not select a responsive-overflow policy. No overflow workflow is provided to assess.

implementation.notes: The source permits collapsing actions into overflow; this specimen does not select a responsive-overflow policy. No overflow workflow is provided to assess.

checks.statement: Let the search field fill the space between leading and trailing elements up to 312dp, then grow only to half of that available space.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Resizing instructions.

evidence.result: Search uses flex:1 and full-width input; there is no 312dp cap or rule limiting growth to half of available width.

implementation.notes: Search uses flex:1 and full-width input; there is no 312dp cap or rule limiting growth to half of available width.

checks.statement: Mirror leading/trailing app bar layout for right-to-left languages.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Presentation instructions.

evidence.result: The row, expanded title, and action placement use logical inline padding/insets and margin-inline-start, allowing direction-based mirroring.

implementation.notes: The row, expanded title, and action placement use logical inline padding/insets and margin-inline-start, allowing direction-based mirroring.

checks.statement: An app bar may remain fixed or hide/reappear with scrolling; a transparent scrolled container is also allowed when its icon buttons receive container fills, and narrow icon buttons may save space for actions such as Back.
checks.condition: When choosing a scrolled app bar treatment.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scrolling instructions.

evidence.result: The bar remains sticky and tokenized; no hide/reappear or transparent scrolled-container treatment is implemented in the inspected app-bar behavior/CSS. Generated tokens may configure fill, but optional icon fills are not resolved here.

implementation.notes: The bar remains sticky and tokenized; no hide/reappear or transparent scrolled-container treatment is implemented in the inspected app-bar behavior/CSS. Generated tokens may configure fill, but optional icon fills are not resolved here.

checks.statement: On scroll, flexible medium and large app bars may collapse to small and should remain small until the page returns to the top; do not transform them into a search app bar.
checks.condition: When using the flexible scroll transformation.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scrolling instructions.

evidence.result: This specimen does not offer the optional flexible-to-small scroll transformation. Its scrolled treatment is a different configuration; the source condition explicitly refers to using the transformation.

implementation.notes: This specimen does not offer the optional flexible-to-small scroll transformation. Its scrolled treatment is a different configuration; the source condition explicitly refers to using the transformation.

checks.statement: Expose the current page, app bar actions and destinations, and continued access to app bar actions while page content scrolls.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Use cases instructions.

evidence.result: The group and action labels are present, and actions remain in the sticky bar, but the title is a span and page/destination semantics are not supplied by this preview.

implementation.notes: The group and action labels are present, and actions remain in the sticky bar, but the title is a span and page/destination semantics are not supplied by this preview.

checks.statement: Show a touch ripple when an app bar icon button is tapped.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Touch instructions.

evidence.result: App-bar icon actions use shared icon-button styles and button state-layer variables; actual touch ripple rendering is supplied through shared button assets, not exercised in this code-only review.

implementation.notes: App-bar icon actions use shared icon-button styles and button state-layer variables; actual touch ripple rendering is supplied through shared button assets, not exercised in this code-only review.

checks.statement: Show a hover cue and ripple when an app bar interactive element is hovered or clicked.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Cursor instructions.

evidence.result: Generator maps hovered app-bar tokens and shared pointer listeners create ripple feedback, but app-bar CSS does not connect the generated hover state-layer roles to the icon-button state variables; rendered hover cue is unresolved.

implementation.notes: Generator maps hovered app-bar tokens and shared pointer listeners create ripple feedback, but app-bar CSS does not connect the generated hover state-layer roles to the icon-button state variables; rendered hover cue is unresolved.

checks.statement: Show a focus indicator for interactive app bar elements, then perform their action when selected.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Keyboard or switch instructions.

evidence.result: Focus indicator token bindings exist, but the inspected icon-button/app-bar CSS contains no explicit focus outline rule for the app-bar actions; browser-native focus styling was not exercised.

implementation.notes: Focus indicator token bindings exist, but the inspected icon-button/app-bar CSS contains no explicit focus outline rule for the app-bar actions; browser-native focus styling was not exercised.

checks.statement: Use design-token-backed color values for app bars.
checks.condition: When implementing app bar color roles.
checks.notes: The specs explain that designers select token-corresponding colors and implementations reference token values.

sourceHistory.summary: The specs explain that designers select token-corresponding colors and implementations reference token values.

evidence.result: Generator maps app-bar container, title, subtitle, and icon roles to custom properties consumed by the app-bar stylesheet.

implementation.notes: Generator maps app-bar container, title, subtitle, and icon roles to custom properties consumed by the app-bar stylesheet.

checks.statement: Expose the app bar title with the Title role; label icon buttons by the action they take and expose them as Button controls.
checks.condition: For app bars announced by screen readers.
checks.notes: The source says screen readers announce UI text followed by its role; its examples identify Title and Button roles.

sourceHistory.summary: The source says screen readers announce UI text followed by its role; its examples identify Title and Button roles.

evidence.result: Title is a span inside a group, not exposed with the Title role; leading/trailing controls are native buttons with labels, but title-role requirement is absent.

implementation.notes: Title is a span inside a group, not exposed with the Title role; leading/trailing controls are native buttons with labels, but title-role requirement is absent.
